title: Equal-Budget Monte Carlo Tree Search versus Randomized-Restart List Scheduling for DAG Workflows: A Controlled Equal-Budget Computational Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.12542v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is often proposed for scheduling directed-acyclic-graph (DAG) workflows, yet most studies never run the comparison that could refute it - giving a much simpler method the same search effort. We run that comparison under a controlled protocol. All arms receive an identical budget - the same number of candidate schedules built and evaluated: an MCTS scheduling method, preregistered as the main arm; a randomized-restart list scheduler with no search tree as the control; and a textbook-UCT MCTS arm as a registered follow-up on the same domain. The analysis plan was locked before data collection; an independent checker confirmed all 768 confirmation-stage schedules valid with correct finish times. At the main budget of 2048 evaluated schedules, MCTS is 2.88% worse than the restarts (95% CI [-3.62%,-2.15%]; the 72 of 96 held-out instances with positive baseline-relative headroom). The deficit is not budget starva

translated_title: 等预算蒙特卡洛树搜索与随机重启列表调度在DAG工作流上的对比：一项受控等预算计算研究
translated_abstract: 蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）常被提出用于调度有向无环图（DAG）工作流，但大多数研究从未进行过可能推翻该结论的对比实验——即给予一个简单得多的方法相同的搜索预算。我们在受控协议下进行了这项对比实验。所有方法分支获得完全相同的预算——构建和评估的候选调度数量相同：一个MCTS调度方法（预注册为主要分支）；一个不含搜索树的随机重启列表调度器（作为对照组）；以及一个教科书式UCT的MCTS分支（作为在同一领域上的注册后续实验）。分析计划在数据收集之前就已锁定；一名独立检查员确认了确认阶段的全部768个调度均有效且完成时间计算正确。在主预算为2048个被评估调度的条件下，MCTS比随机重启方法差2.88%（95%置信区间[-3.62%, -2.15%]；在96个保留实例中有72个相对于基线存在正向提升空间）。这一性能劣势并非源于预算不足（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 在严格控制的等计算预算实验中，简单的随机重启列表调度方法在DAG工作流调度上比蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）好2.88%，表明更复杂的搜索方法并不必然优于简单基线。
en_tdlr: Under a controlled equal-budget comparison, a simple randomized-restart list scheduler outperforms Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) for DAG workflow scheduling by 2.88%, demonstrating that more complex search methods do not necessarily beat simple baselines.
